measurement: 3 alternating repeats; one fresh process per case, 4 warmups and six 200ms iterations at 1024 rows. No concurrent build/test/profile load.
database: Disposable Docker PostgreSQL 14.23 (Debian 14.23-1.pgdg13+1); loopback TCP from local client to Docker VM. Container removed after timing and live tests.
local_source_note: Timed binary was built before committing identical execution source as 95009d8c; later test assertions and documentation do not change timed code.
authority: Existing PostgresEntityRepository already ingested directly into ordinal storage before this change. New dictionary realization is an internal differential reference, not a new public ingestion strategy. Public/default routing remains ordinal.
boundary: Real query execution, wire transfer, native decode, shape and entity validation, identity/partition/version/xmin reconstruction, retained EntitySnapshot and DTO, reader disposal. Excludes connection opening, pool checkout, compilation, table setup and serialization.
scope: Entity snapshot provenance only. Query-row join-contributor lineage is not implemented by this experiment.
